name: Status Chips
description: More chips for the status bar under the terminal: git upstream and stashes, package managers and Python environments, Kubernetes, cloud and Docker contexts, listening ports, and the machine at the other end of an SSH session. Arrange them in Settings › Status Bar.
author: Octet

statusItems.name: Ahead / behind
statusItems.summary: Commits ahead of and behind the upstream branch

statusItems.name: Stashes
statusItems.summary: How many stashes the repository holds

statusItems.name: Last commit
statusItems.summary: How long ago the last commit was; its subject on hover

statusItems.name: Package manager
statusItems.summary: Which package manager the project's lockfile belongs to

statusItems.name: Node version check
statusItems.summary: Warns when .nvmrc or .node-version asks for another Node

statusItems.name: Python environment
statusItems.summary: The project's virtualenv, conda environment or pyenv version

statusItems.name: Kubernetes context
statusItems.summary: kubectl's current context and namespace; red for production

statusItems.name: AWS profile
statusItems.summary: The AWS profile and region commands would use

statusItems.name: Azure subscription
statusItems.summary: The subscription the Azure CLI is signed in to

statusItems.name: Docker
statusItems.summary: Docker's context, and running compose services for this project

statusItems.name: Terraform workspace
statusItems.summary: The Terraform workspace selected in this folder

statusItems.name: .env files
statusItems.summary: Whether the project has .env files; variable names (never values) on hover

statusItems.name: Listening ports
statusItems.summary: Ports the pane's programs listen on, like a dev server; click to open

statusItems.name: CPU & memory
statusItems.summary: What the pane's programs use, while they're busy

statusItems.name: Remote system
statusItems.summary: The SSH machine's system and uptime (key or agent sign-in only)

statusItems.name: Remote latency
statusItems.summary: Round-trip time to the SSH machine; amber when slow
